name: lint
description: Lint a design with its configured engines (Verilator, Verible, Slang, Yosys, GHDL, svlint, CDC). Returns findings with rule, severity and file:line. A failed or missing engine fails the run; it is never reported clean.

new_only.description: Fail the gate on findings absent from the baseline.

name: rule
description: What a lint rule checks, its default severity and help link, by the engineId/ruleId a finding gives. Only cdc and constraints rules have a sentence.

name: waivers
description: The waivers in force for a project: rule, scope, reason, author and expiry. Read only; a waiver is a person's decision.
